## BIGNUMERIC

# The whole range, with 38 fractional digits.
SELECT BIGNUMERIC '578960446186580977117854925043439539266.34992332820282019728792003956564819967'
=> "578960446186580977117854925043439539266.34992332820282019728792003956564819967"

SELECT BIGNUMERIC '-578960446186580977117854925043439539266.34992332820282019728792003956564819968'
=> "-578960446186580977117854925043439539266.34992332820282019728792003956564819968"

SELECT BIGNUMERIC '0.00000000000000000000000000000000000001'
=> "0.00000000000000000000000000000000000001"

SELECT CAST(NULL AS BIGNUMERIC)
=> null

# Comparisons and sorting tell apart values that differ in the last digit.
SELECT x > BIGNUMERIC '99999999999999999999999999999999999999.99999999999999999999999999999999999999'
FROM UNNEST([BIGNUMERIC '1e38']) x
=> "true"

SELECT x = BIGNUMERIC '0.1' FROM UNNEST([BIGNUMERIC '0.10000000000000000000000000000000000001']) x
=> "false"

SELECT x BETWEEN -1 AND 0 FROM UNNEST([BIGNUMERIC '-0.00000000000000000000000000000000000001']) x
=> "true"

SELECT x IN (1, 2) FROM UNNEST([BIGNUMERIC '2']) x
=> "true"

SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY(
  SELECT CAST(x AS STRING)
  FROM UNNEST([BIGNUMERIC '3', -1e38, 0.5, -0.00000000000000000000000000000000000001]) x
  ORDER BY x), ',')
=> "-100000000000000000000000000000000000000,-0.00000000000000000000000000000000000001,0.5,3"

SELECT MAX(x) FROM UNNEST([BIGNUMERIC '1e38', 0.00000000000000000000000000000000000001]) x
=> "100000000000000000000000000000000000000"

SELECT MIN(x) FROM UNNEST([BIGNUMERIC '-1e38', 0.00000000000000000000000000000000000001]) x
=> "-100000000000000000000000000000000000000"

SELECT GREATEST(x, BIGNUMERIC '1') FROM UNNEST([BIGNUMERIC '1.00000000000000000000000000000000000001']) x
=> "1.00000000000000000000000000000000000001"

SELECT LEAST(x, NULL) FROM UNNEST([BIGNUMERIC '1']) x
=> null

# Carrying values.
SELECT IF(x > 0, x, NULL) FROM UNNEST([BIGNUMERIC '1e38']) x
=> "100000000000000000000000000000000000000"

SELECT COALESCE(NULL, x) FROM UNNEST([BIGNUMERIC '0.5']) x
=> "0.5"

SELECT CASE x WHEN 1 THEN x END FROM UNNEST([BIGNUMERIC '1']) x
=> "1"

SELECT [x, 2][OFFSET(0)] FROM UNNEST([BIGNUMERIC '1e-38']) x
=> "0.00000000000000000000000000000000000001"

SELECT ARRAY_AGG(x ORDER BY x)[OFFSET(1)] FROM UNNEST([BIGNUMERIC '1e38', -1e38]) x
=> "100000000000000000000000000000000000000"

SELECT MAX(l) FROM (SELECT LAG(x) OVER (ORDER BY x) AS l FROM UNNEST([BIGNUMERIC '1e38', 2, 3]) x)
=> "3"

SELECT MAX(f) FROM (SELECT FIRST_VALUE(x) OVER (ORDER BY x) AS f FROM UNNEST([BIGNUMERIC '1e38', 2]) x)
=> "2"

# Addition, subtraction and negation are exact, and fail when out of range.
SELECT x + BIGNUMERIC '0.00000000000000000000000000000000000002' FROM UNNEST([BIGNUMERIC '0.1']) x
=> "0.10000000000000000000000000000000000002"

SELECT x - BIGNUMERIC '1e38' FROM UNNEST([BIGNUMERIC '1']) x
=> "-99999999999999999999999999999999999999"

SELECT -x FROM UNNEST([BIGNUMERIC '-0.5']) x
=> "0.5"

SELECT x + 1 FROM UNNEST([CAST(NULL AS BIGNUMERIC)]) x
=> null

SELECT SAFE_ADD(x, BIGNUMERIC '1e-38')
FROM UNNEST([BIGNUMERIC '578960446186580977117854925043439539266.34992332820282019728792003956564819967']) x
=> null

SELECT SAFE_SUBTRACT(x, BIGNUMERIC '1e-38')
FROM UNNEST([BIGNUMERIC '-578960446186580977117854925043439539266.34992332820282019728792003956564819968']) x
=> null

SELECT SAFE_NEGATE(x)
FROM UNNEST([BIGNUMERIC '-578960446186580977117854925043439539266.34992332820282019728792003956564819968']) x
=> null

# Multiplication and division round half away from zero to 38 fractional digits.
SELECT x * 0.1 FROM UNNEST([BIGNUMERIC '0.00000000000000000000000000000000000005']) x
=> "0.00000000000000000000000000000000000001"

SELECT x * 10 FROM UNNEST([BIGNUMERIC '1e37']) x
=> "100000000000000000000000000000000000000"

SELECT x / 3 FROM UNNEST([BIGNUMERIC '2']) x
=> "0.66666666666666666666666666666666666667"

SELECT x / CAST(NULL AS BIGNUMERIC) FROM UNNEST([BIGNUMERIC '1']) x
=> null

SELECT SAFE_MULTIPLY(x, 2)
FROM UNNEST([BIGNUMERIC '578960446186580977117854925043439539266.34992332820282019728792003956564819967']) x
=> null

SELECT SAFE_DIVIDE(x, 3) FROM UNNEST([BIGNUMERIC '1']) x
=> "0.33333333333333333333333333333333333333"

SELECT SAFE_DIVIDE(x, 0) FROM UNNEST([BIGNUMERIC '1']) x
=> null

SELECT SAFE_DIVIDE(x, BIGNUMERIC '1e-38')
FROM UNNEST([BIGNUMERIC '578960446186580977117854925043439539266.34992332820282019728792003956564819967']) x
=> null

# DIV truncates toward zero, and MOD has the sign of the dividend.
SELECT DIV(x, 2) FROM UNNEST([BIGNUMERIC '-7']) x
=> "-3"

SELECT MOD(x, 2) FROM UNNEST([BIGNUMERIC '-7.5']) x
=> "-1.5"

SELECT MOD(x, 1e-38) FROM UNNEST([BIGNUMERIC '1e38']) x
=> "0"

SELECT SAFE.MOD(x, 0) FROM UNNEST([BIGNUMERIC '1']) x
=> null

SELECT SAFE.DIV(x, 0) FROM UNNEST([BIGNUMERIC '1']) x
=> null

SELECT DIV(x, NULL) FROM UNNEST([BIGNUMERIC '1']) x
=> null

# ABS, SIGN, rounding and truncation keep all 38 fractional digits.
SELECT ABS(x) FROM UNNEST([BIGNUMERIC '-0.00000000000000000000000000000000000001']) x
=> "0.00000000000000000000000000000000000001"

SELECT SAFE.ABS(x)
FROM UNNEST([BIGNUMERIC '-578960446186580977117854925043439539266.34992332820282019728792003956564819968']) x
=> null

SELECT SIGN(x) FROM UNNEST([BIGNUMERIC '-1e-38']) x
=> "-1"

SELECT SIGN(x) FROM UNNEST([BIGNUMERIC '0']) x
=> "0"

SELECT ROUND(x) FROM UNNEST([BIGNUMERIC '-2.5']) x
=> "-3"

SELECT ROUND(x, 37) FROM UNNEST([BIGNUMERIC '1.00000000000000000000000000000000000005']) x
=> "1.0000000000000000000000000000000000001"

SELECT ROUND(x, -1) FROM UNNEST([BIGNUMERIC '15']) x
=> "20"

SELECT ROUND(x, 37, 'ROUND_HALF_EVEN') FROM UNNEST([BIGNUMERIC '1.00000000000000000000000000000000000005']) x
=> "1"

SELECT ROUND(x, 0, 'ROUND_HALF_AWAY_FROM_ZERO') FROM UNNEST([BIGNUMERIC '0.5']) x
=> "1"

SELECT ROUND(x, NULL) FROM UNNEST([BIGNUMERIC '1']) x
=> null

SELECT TRUNC(x) FROM UNNEST([BIGNUMERIC '-1.99999999999999999999999999999999999999']) x
=> "-1"

SELECT TRUNC(x, 37) FROM UNNEST([BIGNUMERIC '1.99999999999999999999999999999999999999']) x
=> "1.9999999999999999999999999999999999999"

SELECT CEIL(x) FROM UNNEST([BIGNUMERIC '1e-38']) x
=> "1"

SELECT CEILING(x) FROM UNNEST([BIGNUMERIC '-1.5']) x
=> "-1"

SELECT FLOOR(x) FROM UNNEST([BIGNUMERIC '-1e-38']) x
=> "-1"

SELECT FLOOR(x) FROM UNNEST([CAST(NULL AS BIGNUMERIC)]) x
=> null

# SUM is exact, and only the total has to fit.
SELECT SUM(x) FROM UNNEST([BIGNUMERIC '1.5', 0.00000000000000000000000000000000000001]) x
=> "1.50000000000000000000000000000000000001"

SELECT SUM(x)
FROM UNNEST([BIGNUMERIC '578960446186580977117854925043439539266.34992332820282019728792003956564819967', 1, -1]) x
=> "578960446186580977117854925043439539266.34992332820282019728792003956564819967"

SELECT MAX(s) FROM (SELECT SUM(x) OVER (ORDER BY x) AS s FROM UNNEST([BIGNUMERIC '1e-38', 1]) x)
=> "1.00000000000000000000000000000000000001"

SELECT SUM(x) FROM UNNEST([CAST(NULL AS BIGNUMERIC)]) x
=> null

# Casts follow GoogleSQL's conversions: a FLOAT64 converts exactly, rounded to 38 digits, and
# INT64 and NUMERIC round half away from zero.
SELECT CAST(x AS BIGNUMERIC) FROM UNNEST([0.1]) x
=> "0.10000000000000000555111512312578270212"

SELECT CAST(x AS BIGNUMERIC) FROM UNNEST(['1.5e2']) x
=> "150"

SELECT CAST(x AS BIGNUMERIC) FROM UNNEST([9223372036854775807]) x
=> "9223372036854775807"

SELECT CAST(x AS BIGNUMERIC) FROM UNNEST([NUMERIC '-1.5']) x
=> "-1.5"

SELECT CAST(x AS INT64) FROM UNNEST([BIGNUMERIC '-2.5']) x
=> "-3"

SELECT CAST(x AS NUMERIC) FROM UNNEST([BIGNUMERIC '1.0000000005']) x
=> "1.000000001"

SELECT CAST(x AS FLOAT64) FROM UNNEST([BIGNUMERIC '0.5']) x
=> "0.5"

SELECT CAST(x AS STRING) FROM UNNEST([BIGNUMERIC '-0.10']) x
=> "-0.1"

SELECT CAST(x AS STRING) FROM UNNEST([CAST(NULL AS BIGNUMERIC)]) x
=> null

SELECT SAFE_CAST(x AS BIGNUMERIC) FROM UNNEST(['x']) x
=> null

SELECT SAFE_CAST(x AS BIGNUMERIC) FROM UNNEST([1e39]) x
=> null

SELECT SAFE_CAST(x AS BIGNUMERIC) FROM UNNEST([CAST('inf' AS FLOAT64)]) x
=> null

SELECT SAFE_CAST(x AS INT64) FROM UNNEST([BIGNUMERIC '1e20']) x
=> null

SELECT SAFE_CAST(x AS NUMERIC) FROM UNNEST([BIGNUMERIC '1e30']) x
=> null
